meaning.en: (med.) Chronic dilatation of capillaries and small arterial branches, producing small, reddish tumors in the skin, as of the face, thighs, etc.

sentences.en: Out of 68 cases, 23 cases were spider telangiectasis, 6 cases were Rosacea, 34 cases were telangiectasis caused by steroids or cosmetics, and 5 cases were localized essential telangiectasis.

sentences.en: Methods Clinical data of 3 cases with intestinal telangiectasis treated recently in our hospital were reviewed.
sentences.vi: Phương pháp Dữ liệu lâm sàng của 3 trường hợp mắc bệnh giãn ruột được điều trị gần đây tại bệnh viện của chúng tôi đã được xem xét.

sentences.en: The patient presented with ivory white scars, telangiectasis, hyperpigmentation and ulcerations on the both lower legs.
